verdict.rationale: Evidence only offers a generic marketing line about CI/CD ('Ship faster with secure, reliable CI/CD') with no mention of organization-level dashboards, workflow run insights, or cross-repo visibility features that would support a devops-lead's need for centralized CI/CD visibility. Missing for 10: any documentation of Actions usage/insights dashboards, org-wide workflow run reporting, or audit/analytics tooling for CI/CD across an organization.
